question: Under full paid-tape coverage, does PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH produce at least one independent mint episode per covered hour, and do its realizable runtime outcomes remain durable rather than top-heavy?

supersedes.v2EvidenceTreatment: Preserve as historical context only. V2 explicitly required any budget change to start a new pre-registration, so no V2 row counts toward V3.

budgetSelection.selectionRule: Raise only the paid-tape event budget enough to cover the frozen 60-minute run at the latest measured demand rate; retain all strategy gates, exits, episode identity, and economic bars.

subscriptionPlan.billingRule: PumpPortal charges 0.01 SOL for each completed 10000-event block; the 2000-event remainder adds no projected block charge.

episodeIdentity: telemetry_run|mint; same-mint reentries within a run count as one episode

throughputCheckpoint.gradeOn: cumulative valid V3 full-coverage runtime sessions

requirements: realized PnL after removing top 3 winning episodes > 0
no single run contributes more than 60% of total positive PnL

prohibitions: No live broadcast enablement from this experiment.
No entry-gate or exit-rule changes while evidence is collecting.
No grading on MFE, maximum excursion, or duplicate same-mint reentries.
V1 and V2 rows cannot count as V3 evidence.
Any later change to curve floor, budget, entry logic, or exit logic starts a new pre-registration.
